metadata.title: Main EU Institutions and Bodies Directory
metadata.description: Complete directory of the seven principal EU institutions, advisory bodies, financial institutions, oversight bodies, and interinstitutional services

principal_institutions.description: The seven principal institutions that govern the European Union

institutions.name: European Parliament
institutions.role: Directly elected legislative body representing EU citizens

institutions.name: European Council
institutions.role: Defines the general political direction and priorities of the EU
institutions.composition: EU heads of state or government, President of the European Council, President of the European Commission

institutions.name: Council of the European Union
institutions.role: Legislative body representing member state governments

institutions.name: European Commission
institutions.role: Executive body proposing legislation and implementing EU policies
institutions.composition: College of 27 Commissioners (one per member state)

institutions.name: Court of Justice of the European Union
institutions.role: Judicial authority ensuring uniform interpretation and application of EU law

institutions.name: European Central Bank
institutions.role: Manages the euro and EU monetary policy

institutions.name: European Court of Auditors
institutions.role: Audits EU finances and ensures proper use of EU funds

advisory_bodies.description: Consultative bodies providing input on EU legislation

bodies.name: European Economic and Social Committee
bodies.role: Represents civil society organizations, employers, workers, and other interest groups
bodies.composition: 329 members representing economic and social stakeholders

bodies.name: European Committee of the Regions
bodies.role: Represents local and regional authorities in EU policymaking
bodies.composition: 329 members from regional and local governments

financial_institutions.description: EU financial institutions supporting investment and economic stability

institutions.name: European Investment Bank
institutions.role: EU's lending institution providing long-term finance for investment projects

institutions.name: European Investment Fund
institutions.role: Supports SMEs through venture capital, guarantees, and microfinance

institutions.name: European Stability Mechanism
institutions.role: Provides financial assistance to eurozone member states in financial difficulty

independent_oversight_bodies.description: Independent bodies ensuring accountability and data protection

bodies.name: European Ombudsman
bodies.role: Investigates complaints about maladministration in EU institutions

bodies.name: European Data Protection Supervisor
bodies.role: Ensures EU institutions and bodies respect privacy when processing personal data

bodies.name: European Data Protection Board
bodies.role: Ensures consistent application of GDPR across the EU
bodies.composition: Representatives from national data protection authorities

interinstitutional_services.description: Shared services supporting multiple EU institutions

services.name: Publications Office of the European Union
services.role: Publishing and distributing EU publications and official documents

services.name: Computer Emergency Response Team for EU Institutions
services.role: Cybersecurity support for EU institutions, bodies, and agencies

services.name: European School of Administration
services.role: Training and professional development for EU staff

additional_significant_bodies.description: Other significant EU bodies with specialized mandates

bodies.name: European External Action Service
bodies.role: EU's diplomatic service managing foreign and security policy
bodies.head: High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy

bodies.name: Single Resolution Board
bodies.role: Manages resolution of failing banks in the Banking Union

bodies.name: European University Institute
bodies.role: Postgraduate teaching and research institution in social sciences
